tools.blocked_by: Two things. Its service refuses requests without an API key once the shared anonymous allowance is used: both requests were answered with a quota message, so it needs a free key from the owner. And its lock is not committed: the hub's dependency scan accepts at most eight npm locks and this would be the ninth. It was installed and started once in the session from the package and checksum recorded here.
